verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says one line of code logs requests from OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, the Vercel AI SDK and more. The docs describe adding two lines to existing OpenAI SDK code to get automatic observability. Community users confirm one-line OpenAI setup, and one LangChain user was running in 4 minutes. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party integration docs for LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK (only the README lists them), and independent hands-on corroboration of the Vercel AI SDK integration.
